answer: Each epoch every identity must crack one fresh cipher bound to its own key and the epoch seed, a task no one can precompute, and seal it in an ivory ledger chaining each entry to the one before, so a visible delta of real work appears every epoch. Two random peers re-derive it: if it checks out the identity keeps its vote, if not its weight falls to zero. An honest agent cracks one cipher per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must crack a thousand ciphers and show a thousand deltas every epoch, each at full cost, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
